title: [29.X]-Purchase invoice lines of type G/L Account where enabling 'Prices Including VAT' and changing the VAT Prod. Posting Group causes recalculation of the Direct Unit Cost Incl. VAT and Line Amount - Related to Bug  632380
summary: Purchase invoice lines of G/L Account type now correctly recalculate VAT-related amounts when enabling prices including VAT and changing the VAT product posting group.
key_points: Fixed incorrect recalculation of Direct Unit Cost and Line Amount when VAT settings change on G/L Account purchase lines
Addresses issue AB#649415 where prices including VAT flag interaction with VAT posting group changes caused calculation errors
Changes applied across all localization layers and includes test adjustments
Small code modifications to Purchase Line table logic
